**Full\-Time \| Non–Exempt**

**Reports to**: Clinical Manager

**Why Nurses Choose YoloCares**


When you join YoloCares, you're joining one of California's highest\-rated nonprofit hospice organizations, where compassionate professionals are empowered to provide exceptional patient care.

**What you can expect:**

* Ranked among the **Top 1% of hospice providers in California** for quality of care
* Nationally ranked among **Modern Healthcare's Best Places to Work for five years, with more than 95% of employees saying they’re proud to work at YoloCares**

As a community\-founded and community\-grounded nonprofit with a nearly 50\-year track record of caring for people living with life\-limiting illnesses, YoloCares is committed to providing compassionate, innovative, and patient\-centered care. Our commitment to this mission is reflected in our accomplishments:

* First California healthcare provider accepted into the prestigious National Partnership for Healthcare \& Hospice Innovation.
* Opened the West Coast's first community housing program for individuals living with a terminal illness who are also experiencing homelessness.
* Created a unique five\-star adult day program in Davis, California.


Our team of professionals sees their work not simply as a job, but as a human response to an inner voice. For many, it is a calling—a vocation dedicated to serving patients and families with compassion, dignity, and respect.

**The** **YoloCares** **Clinical Team**


You will join a highly skilled, compassionate, interdisciplinary clinical team dedicated to providing patient\- and family\-centered hospice care. YoloCares’ clinical team includes registered nurses, hospice aides, social workers, spiritual care counselors, nurse practitioners, and physicians who work collaboratively to support patients and families through every stage of the hospice journey. The team is grounded in clinical excellence, mutual respect, and thoughtful coordination, with a shared commitment to dignity, comfort, and individualized care.

**About the Role**


In this role, you'll build meaningful relationships with patients, families, and community partners. As an RN \- Case Manager, you'll provide compassionate, patient\-centered hospice nursing care while coordinating services across the interdisciplinary care team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Clinical Care**

* Complete comprehensive nursing assessments and ongoing patient evaluations. Provide skilled hospice nursing care and symptom management
* Assess changing patient needs and develop individualized plans of care.
* Educate patients and families regarding medications, disease progression, symptom management, and hospice philosophy.

**Care Coordination**

* Collaborate with physicians, nurse practitioners, social workers, spiritual care counselors, hospice aides, and volunteers.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with partner facilities while coordinating patient care and participating in interdisciplinary care conferences.
* Coordinate medications, durable medical equipment, and medical supplies.
* Communicate changes in patient condition and obtain appropriate physician orders.

**Documentation \& Compliance**

* Complete accurate and timely clinical documentation within established standards.
* Maintain individualized plans of care.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and YoloCares standards.


Requirements:
* Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of California.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of recent clinical nursing experience preferred; experience in home care or hospice care highly desirable.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both verbally and in writing; Spanish language skills are a plus.
* Demonstrated clinical nursing skills and competence, with an understanding of and commitment to the philosophy, principles, and goals of hospice care.

**Physical Requirements**

**To apply for this position:** *Please submit a resume* *and* *cover letter.* Your resume will not be considered if a cover letter is not included.

**About Community HealthWorks**


Community HealthWorks (CoHeWo) advances health equity by helping individuals and families access the health coverage, care, and community services they need to thrive. We work at the intersection of health care and community support, partnering with managed care plans, health systems, community\-based organizations, and government agencies to remove barriers to care.


Our team provides community\-based navigation, care coordination, and outreach services that connect people to health coverage, primary care, public benefits, housing support, and other critical resources that improve well\-being.


Community Health Workers are central to this work, serving as trusted connectors between communities and the systems designed to support them.

**Position Summary**


The Community Health Worker (CHW) – Patient Navigation provides direct patient navigation services within Sacramento\-area hospital emergency departments and healthcare settings.


This role works directly with patients to identify healthcare and social needs, connect individuals to primary care and community resources, coordinate referrals, and support continuity of care following hospital encounters. The CHW serves as a bridge between patients, healthcare providers, health plans, and community organizations to help individuals access appropriate services and reduce barriers to care.


Services may include primary care linkage, Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) screening, transportation coordination, Enhanced Care Management (ECM) referrals, Community Supports referrals, health plan navigation, and connection to community resources.


This role is non\-supervisory.

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

**Patient** **Navigation \& Care Coordination**

* Engage patients within hospital emergency department and healthcare settings to assess healthcare and social support needs.
* Assist patients in connecting to primary care providers, specialty care, and community resources.
* Schedule follow\-up appointments and support continuity of care after hospital visits.
* Coordinate referrals between healthcare providers, health plans, hospitals, and community\-based organizations.
* Conduct follow\-up activities to support successful service linkage and care coordination.

**Resource Navigation** **\& Support**

* Conduct Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) screenings and identify barriers to care.
* Connect patients to community resources, transportation services, and supportive programs.
* Screen for Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Supports eligibility and facilitate referrals when appropriate.
* Educate patients about available healthcare services, health plan benefits, and community resources.

**Documentation \& Data Integrity**

* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in Salesforce, Unite Us, and other approved systems.
* Document patient interactions, referrals, services provided, and outcomes in accordance with program requirements.
* Collaborate with hospital staff, health plans, healthcare providers, and community partners to support positive patient outcomes.
* Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and continuous improvement activities.

**Education \& Experience**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate degree in social services, psychology, public health, healthcare, or related field preferred.
* Two (2\) years of experience in health care, social services, community outreach, case management, interpreting, or client\-focused roles preferred.
* Familiarity with Medi\-Cal, CalAIM, healthcare navigation, or community\-based services preferred.
* Knowledge of Medi\-Cal managed care plans, CalAIM programs, and Community Health Worker (CHW) services is a plus.

**Skills \& Attributes**

* Ability to work effectively with diverse communities and individuals experiencing health or social barriers.
* Strong communication, organizational, and relationship\-building skills.

* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

**Requirements**

**Community Supports Housing Navigator \& Life Skills Specialist**
==================================================================


Position Summary  

Simple Solutions Psychotherapy is seeking a compassionate, motivated, and resourceful Community Supports Housing Navigator \& Life Skills Specialist to join our CalAIM Community Supports team. This position plays a vital role in helping individuals experiencing housing instability obtain and maintain safe, stable housing while promoting long\-term independence through care coordination, financial literacy, and life skills development.  

The Housing Navigator works collaboratively with Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Care Managers, healthcare providers, landlords, housing authorities, and community partners to assist members throughout every phase of the housing process—from locating permanent housing and securing move\-in resources to supporting long\-term housing stability.  

This position requires strong advocacy skills, knowledge of community resources, excellent organizational abilities, and a commitment to person\-centered, trauma\-informed care.  

Essential Duties \& Responsibilities  

Housing Navigation \& Placement  

* Conduct comprehensive housing needs assessments and identify barriers to obtaining permanent housing.
* Develop individualized housing plans that align with each member's goals and needs.
* Assist members in locating affordable housing opportunities, including apartments, shared housing, and subsidized housing programs.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with landlords, property managers, housing authorities, and community housing partners.
* Coordinate apartment searches, property tours, housing applications, and lease signings.
* Assist members with gathering required documentation and completing housing applications.
* Advocate on behalf of members throughout the housing search and placement process.

Housing Move\-In Assistance  

* Coordinate security deposits, utility deposits, and other approved housing\-related financial assistance.
* Obtain required documentation from landlords and property managers.
* Verify member eligibility for Community Supports housing services.
* Process move\-in assistance requests in accordance with DHCS and health plan requirements.
* Maintain accurate records, receipts, invoices, and payment documentation.

Housing Transition \& Independent Living Support  

* Coordinate move\-in dates and transition planning.
* Assist members with obtaining furniture, household essentials, and other necessary items to establish a safe living environment.
* Coordinate utility activation and other move\-in logistics.
* Connect members to community resources that support long\-term housing success.
* Monitor members' transition into permanent housing and address barriers as they arise.

Housing Stability \& Tenancy Support  

* Conduct home visits to assess housing stability and member well\-being.
* Monitor compliance with lease agreements and assist members in understanding tenant rights and responsibilities.
* Provide landlord mediation and conflict resolution support.
* Deliver eviction prevention services through early intervention and problem\-solving.
* Assist members with budgeting, household management, and maintaining housing stability.
* Develop individualized housing stability plans and monitor progress toward goals.

Financial Literacy \& Life Skills Education  

* Facilitate individual and group workshops focused on budgeting, financial literacy, credit building, banking, money management, and financial wellness.
* Educate members on managing rent, utilities, and household expenses.
* Teach strategies for building and repairing credit and increasing financial independence.
* Assist members in developing savings plans and long\-term financial goals.
* Provide life skills training related to independent living, lease compliance, household management, communication, problem\-solving, and self\-sufficiency.
* Monitor participation, document progress, and reinforce practical skills that promote long\-term success.

Care Coordination  

* Collaborate closely with Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Care Managers and interdisciplinary treatment teams.
* Participate in case conferences and multidisciplinary care planning meetings.
* Coordinate referrals to medical, behavioral health, substance use treatment, and community\-based services.
* Maintain regular communication with members, providers, landlords, and community partners.
* Advocate for members to ensure access to appropriate services and resources.

Documentation \& Compliance  

* Complete all required Community Supports documentation within established timelines.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in the electronic health record (EHR).

**Job Summary**


The Nurse Case Manager (NCM) is a member of the core interdisciplinary team responsible for the care and case management of patient/families admitted to hospice service. The NCM, in collaboration with pt/family, physician and interdisciplinary team, develops and coordinates an individualized Plan of Care (POC) that reflects pt/family goals related to Safe \& Comfortable Dying, Self\-Determined Life Closure and Effective Bereavement. The NCM demonstrates sensitivity and compassion for the issues involved with serving patients and families facing a terminal illness, death and bereavement; clinical competence in pain and symptom management; and fiscal responsibility in the planning and delivery of services. The Nurse Case Manager provides direct supervision for Hospice Aides and LVNs, when utilized.


**Essential Responsibilities**

**Patient/family care**

* Recognizes the patient and family as the "unit of care" and active members in the development of the POC
* Respects patient right to self\-determination and acts as advocate within the context of the values and ethical standards of HSCC. Meets pt/family where they are
* Utilizes nursing process in providing primary care to pt/families
* Documents all care and care planning per agency policy
* Provides nursing interventions for pt/family as ordered by the physician and in accordance with the POC, safe nursing practice and the policies and procedures of HSCC
* Assesses and monitors management of pain and symptoms in collaboration with patient/family, IDG and physician to achieve maximum comfort
* Exercises good clinical judgment
* Administers medications and treatments as ordered prn
* Demonstrates the ability to articulate the parameters of hospice care and services
* Demonstrates the ability to work with pt/families under stress \& in crisis

* Reviews and considers patient data gathered by LVN/HHA when developing and revising the plan of care.
* Instructs and supports pt/family unit re: symptom mgmt, patient care, disease process \& death/dying
* Participates in providing after\-hours coverage to pt/family as needed

* Plans \& provides care within the structure of the Conditions of Participation \& the Hospice Medicare/Medi\-Cal Benefit

* Opens, closes \& revises POC per HSCC guidelines
* Documents all contacts/instructions/ interventions per HSCC policies \& procedures
* Obtains medications, medical supplies and equipment per pt need/physician order
* Demonstrates understanding of pharmacy\-related policies \& procedures

* Completes Recertification documentation in a timely and accurate manner
* Exercises professional management and coordinates care between and among involved parties in home, SNF and RCFE setting
* Provides concise and timely on call reports
* Submits completed paperwork \& time sheets within the timeframes per HSCC policies \& procedures

* Submits verification of current employment related documents per HSCC policies, procedures and licensing agencies
* Completes and submits all documentation in accordance with policies and procedures
* Participates in activities that affirm, enhance and develop the highest quality standards for HSCC
* Participates in developing standards for quality patient care within HSCC
* Participates in Quality Assessment \& Improvement activities as requested
* Verbal communication is concise, organized and timely per HSCC guidelines
* Completes and submits all documentation in accordance with policies and procedures
* Submits verification of current RN License, ongoing TB status/tests and passes OIG/GSA/SAM checks per HSCC policies, procedures and licensing agencies

* Functions as a member of the HSCC IDG maintaining open \& organized communication with hospice staff, volunteers and supervisor
* Functions as Nurse Case Manager for hospice pts/families in the coordination/provision of nursing services
* Participates in IDG meeting per protocol to promote problem solving, care planning and learning
* Maintains open, organized and timely communication with hospice staff / volunteers
* Works collaboratively with IDG to develop common goals to meet the needs of the patient and family

**Special Projects**

* Participates in special projects as requested
* Performs other related job duties as assigned by Supervisor

**Compliance**

* Ensures all HIPAA Privacy and Security Regulations, Medicare Conditions of Participation, and all other regulatory/compliance requirements are understood and followed
* Submits verification of current RN license
* Ensures TB/FIT checks are completed in a timely manner; at least annually

**Requirements**

**Certifications, Licenses, Registrations**

* Require current California RN license
* Valid state driver's license and liability auto insurance
* Pass OIG/GSA/SAM review and all required background checks

**Education/Experience**

* Degree in Nursing from an accredited college
* 2\-5 years RN experience in hospice, oncology, medsurg, ICU, ER, skilled nursing facilities or homecare
* 1 year minimum of Acute care experience preferred
* Previous experience working with electronic medical record charting is desirable

The Student Care Coordinator provides non\-clinical case management and behavioral intervention support in the Dean of Students (DoS) Office. Reporting to the Assistant Dean of Students and working closely with the Dean of Students team and several campus partners, this position coordinates case management processes, provides individualized student support, manages policy implementation, and implements student support in a way that fosters community, promotes belonging, and supports student success.  



In this role you will:  

* Provide case management, individualized student support, and administrative intake for a wide range of concerns involving undergraduate and graduate students. Manage case intake, coordination, documentation, compliance reporting, and referrals. Apply knowledge of case management and behavioral intervention principles to appropriately escalate and refer cases.
* Collaborate with a wide range of campus partners to facilitate student support and intervention. This includes participating in the Weekly Incident Debrief (WID), Behavioral Intervention Team (BIT), Alcohol and Other Drugs (AOD) case management team, and other ad hoc case management meetings. Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, present cases, compile notes, document interventions, and track follow\-up for concerns relevant to these and other campus partner coordination groups.

The Agency

Since 1975, Pathways of Hope has led a community effort to provide access to food, shelter and housing to those in North Orange County experiencing hunger, housing insecurity and homelessness. Through multiple housing models (Emergency Shelter, Permanent Supportive Housing, Prevention and Diversion) the Pathways of Hope Housing team assists homeless families and individuals reduce housing barriers, work toward greater economic opportunity and independence, and strengthen community social service linkages necessary for the participant(s) to end their homelessness and obtain safe, sustainable, permanent housing.

**Job Summary**


The Nurse Case Manager (NCM) is a member of the core interdisciplinary team responsible for the care and case management of patient/families admitted to hospice service. The NCM, in collaboration with pt/family, physician and interdisciplinary team, develops and coordinates an individualized Plan of Care (POC) that reflects pt/family goals related to Safe \& Comfortable Dying, Self\-Determined Life Closure and Effective Bereavement. The NCM demonstrates sensitivity and compassion for the issues involved with serving patients and families facing a terminal illness, death and bereavement; clinical competence in pain and symptom management; and fiscal responsibility in the planning and delivery of services. The Nurse Case Manager provides direct supervision for Hospice Aides and LVNs, when utilized.


**Essential Responsibilities**

**Patient/family care**

* Recognizes the patient and family as the "unit of care" and active members in the development of the POC
* Respects patient right to self\-determination and acts as advocate within the context of the values and ethical standards of HSCC. Meets pt/family where they are
* Utilizes nursing process in providing primary care to pt/families
* Documents all care and care planning per agency policy
* Provides nursing interventions for pt/family as ordered by the physician and in accordance with the POC, safe nursing practice and the policies and procedures of HSCC
* Assesses and monitors management of pain and symptoms in collaboration with patient/family, IDG and physician to achieve maximum comfort
* Exercises good clinical judgment
* Administers medications and treatments as ordered prn
* Demonstrates the ability to articulate the parameters of hospice care and services
* Demonstrates the ability to work with pt/families under stress \& in crisis
* Develops, manages, reviews \& revises HA POC \& supervises HA performance per HSCC policies \& procedures
* Reviews and considers patient data gathered by LVN/HHA when developing and revising the plan of care.
* Instructs and supports pt/family unit re: symptom mgmt, patient care, disease process \& death/dying
* Participates in providing after\-hours coverage to pt/family as needed

* Plans \& provides care within the structure of the Conditions of Participation \& the Hospice Medicare/Medi\-Cal Benefit

* Opens, closes \& revises POC per HSCC guidelines
* Documents all contacts/instructions/ interventions per HSCC policies \& procedures
* Obtains medications, medical supplies and equipment per pt need/physician order
* Demonstrates understanding of pharmacy\-related policies \& procedures
* Assess patient's continued appropriateness for hospice care per HSCC Recertification protocols
* Completes Recertification documentation in a timely and accurate manner
* Exercises professional management and coordinates care between and among involved parties in home, SNF and RCFE setting
* Provides concise and timely on call reports
* Submits completed paperwork \& time sheets within the timeframes per HSCC policies \& procedures

* Submits verification of current employment related documents per HSCC policies, procedures and licensing agencies
* Completes and submits all documentation in accordance with policies and procedures
* Participates in activities that affirm, enhance and develop the highest quality standards for HSCC
* Participates in developing standards for quality patient care within HSCC
* Participates in Quality Assessment \& Improvement activities as requested
* Verbal communication is concise, organized and timely per HSCC guidelines
* Completes and submits all documentation in accordance with policies and procedures
* Submits verification of current RN License, ongoing TB status/tests and passes OIG/GSA/SAM checks per HSCC policies, procedures and licensing agencies

* Functions as Nurse Case Manager for hospice pts/families in the coordination/provision of nursing services
* Participates in IDG meeting per protocol to promote problem solving, care planning and learning
* Maintains open, organized and timely communication with hospice staff / volunteers
* Works collaboratively with IDG to develop common goals to meet the needs of the patient and family

**Special Projects**

* Participates in special projects as requested
* Performs other related job duties as assigned by Supervisor

* Ensures all HIPAA Privacy and Security Regulations, Medicare Conditions of Participation, and all other regulatory/compliance requirements are understood and followed
* Submits verification of current RN license
* Ensures TB/FIT checks are completed in a timely manner; at least annually

**Certifications, Licenses, Registrations**

* Require current California RN license
* Valid state driver's license and liability auto insurance
* Pass OIG/GSA/SAM review and all required background checks

* Degree in Nursing from an accredited college
* 2\-5 years RN experience in hospice, oncology, medsurg, ICU, ER, skilled nursing facilities or homecare
* 1 year minimum of Acute care experience preferred
* Previous experience working with electronic medical record charting is desirable
* Hospice and/or home health experience preferred
* End\-of\-life and pain management experience preferred

Welcome to the Lake Forest Animal Clinic, where our priority is upholding the highest standard of patient care. As an established and highly respected AAHA\-accredited practice, we maintain a commitment to excellence that is recognized by the community, reflected in our outstanding 4\.7\-star Google rating. We are looking for experienced and dedicated veterinary professionals ready to join a team focused on providing comprehensive, compassionate medical care. If you are seeking a supportive environment where you can truly do your best work, this is your opportunity. Joining our team means becoming part of a supportive network dedicated to your professional success. We believe strongly in investing in our teammates, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth regardless of your career stage. Whether your goal is becoming a credentialed technician, moving into a leadership role, or expanding your clinical knowledge, you will find programs and mentorship in place to help you achieve those career milestones. We focus on providing the workflow support you need so you can concentrate on patient care, knowing your contributions are valued and celebrated. At Lake Forest Animal Clinic, our AAHA accreditation ensures you are practicing top\-tier veterinary medicine in a state\-of\-the\-art facility. We are equipped with advanced diagnostic tools, including in\-house Ultrasound capabilities, and offer specialized care like Cardiology services. Beyond our immediate facility resources, our affiliation provides you with access to internal specialty consultations. This means you have a built\-in support system of experts to collaborate on complex cases, ensuring you always have the resources necessary to deliver excellent patient outcomes. Located in beautiful Lake Forest, California, you will be working in a vibrant community known for its natural beauty and proximity to major Southern California attractions. This area offers a fantastic quality of life with excellent access to outdoor recreation, parks, and easy commutes. Enjoy the benefits of practicing high\-quality medicine in a welcoming community that offers sunshine and a superior lifestyle year\-round.  

### **Your Impact as a Patient Care Coordinator**


As a Patient Care Coordinator, you will be the central point of contact for our clients, guiding them through their entire visit from check\-in to check\-out. You will serve as a vital link between the client and the medical team, capturing medical notes, creating treatment plans, and coordinating all aspects of patient care to ensure a seamless and supportive experience.

### **Your Impact Will Include:**

* **Setting the Stage for a Great Visit:** You'll contact clients before their appointments to set expectations, answer questions, and ensure they are prepared for their visit.
* **Acting as a Medical Scribe:** You will be in the exam room to capture real\-time medical information from the veterinarian, ensuring all records are accurate and up\-to\-date.
* **Creating Treatment Plans:** You'll create, present, and clearly explain treatment plans to clients in accordance with the veterinarian's directions.
* **Coordinating Seamless Care:** You will collaborate with the technical team to ensure the veterinarian's treatment plan is completed efficiently and handle all in\-room check\-outs, including payments and scheduling follow\-ups.
* **Educating Clients:** You'll clearly explain discharge instructions, ensure prescription fulfillment, and address any client inquiries.
* **Following Up with Care:** You will conduct post\-visit follow\-ups to check on the well\-being of pets and communicate any test results.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A high school diploma or equivalent.
* A genuine love for animals and a passion for delivering exceptional client service.
* A friendly, personable, and empathetic demeanor.
* Proficient in active listening, with strong computer literacy and typing skills for accurate medical transcription.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
